book.name: Nambas
book.title: Nambas Wen Detlot Isreil Pipul Bin Jidan Langa Deset Kantri

content: “Yu dalim detlot Isreil pipul blanga gibit yu twelbala longwan wokinstik, wan brom ebri lida brom ebri klen. Yu garra raidimdan ebri men neim langa im ronwan wokinstik.
En raidimdan Eran neim langa det stik blanga det Libai klen. Wanbala wokinstik garra jidan blanga ebri klen.
Yu deigim detlot wokinstik langa det Seikridwan Tent blanga mi, en yu pudum lida langa det Seikridwan Boks weya ai oldei tok langa yu.
Wal ai garra pikimat wanbala men en det men wokinstik na garra abum lif. Lagijat na ai garra stapam detlot Isreil pipul brom grambulbat langa yu.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
Wal Mosis bin tok langa ol detlot Isreil pipul na, en langa ebri lida brom ebri klen bin gibit Mosis im wokinstik, en detlot wokinstik bin twelbala, en blanga Eran wokinstik du.
Mosis bin pudum detlot wokinstik insaid langa det Seikridwan Tent na, lida langa det Seikridwan Boks blanga YAWEI.
Neksdei na, wen Mosis bin go insaid langa det Seikridwan Tent imbin luk blanga Eran wokinstik bin abum nyuwan lif na en purdiflawa en daga gulum aman.
Mosis bin gajim detlot wokinstik en imbin shoum langa ol detlot Isreil pipul wanim bin hepin, en ebri lida bin deigimbek olabat ronwan wokinstik.

YAWEI bin tok langa Mosis, “Yu pudumbek det wokinstik blanga Eran insaid lida langa det Seikridwan Boks. Det wokinstik garra jidan woning blanga ol detlot Isreil pipul wulijim olabat garra dai if olabat nomo stap grambulbat.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
Mosis bin dum wanim YAWEI bin dalim im.
Detlot Isreil pipul bin tok langa Mosis na, “Wal melabat binij na, if enibodi hu kaman gulijap langa det Seikridwan Tent garra dai, wal maitbi melabat holot garra ol dai du.” Lagijat na deibin tok.
